Breathing is a ~5px blob fused to the top of ε with no visible notch or tail direction; the line has no other breathing to compare with (Στοὺς, χαμπουρώνει carry only accents).

Breathing under the circumflex has its head top-right and runs down-left ('(' / upper 'c'), the mirror of the clear ')' smooth breathing of ἀρηίθοον in the line; identical in shape to the P011 εἷλεν mark of the same font.

Breathing under the circumflex has its head top-LEFT with the tail running down-right (smooth, like ἐὺς), the exact mirror of the rough breathing under the circumflex of ὧς in the same line (head top-right, body down-left, notch on the right).

The detached blob over ι sits at x-height level (top of ω/μ), well below the accent zone where the grave of ά and the acute of μόνο sit; it is the broken-off top of the iota stem, not an acute. The only accent is the grave on α.
